summary: Nora now writes video prompts the way MiniMax H3 reads them: she names each reference photo by its number, describes the subject as the photo shows it, and writes camera moves, spoken lines and on-screen text in the model's own conventions.
limitations: Untested on a live clip yet.
Making a photo itself the opening frame (first-frame mode) is a separate change; until then a photo that should move is described in the prompt.
